title: Welcome
content: Hi there, this is my blog's new look. You know, sometimes people get boring, so they do whatever they want to kill it. Somehow, in this case, I'd love to build my own blog as it is, to tell the world what I see. Now, we know how it feels to be. Just visit Recent Posts to get update of me. Someone told me, "I'm down to my last licks". Do you know what it means?
author: 9r3i

title: Semua lebih berarti apabila dihayati
content:
You won't believe it, this is all started from: "Semua lebih berarti apabila dihayati" It's coming from the idea since 2015, I really wanted to create something simple but powerful and can run anywhere. And this blog is just started from: 
const {mia}=require(__dirname+'/private/mia');
new mia;
Yeah, that's all there is to it.

title: Yang takkan terlupakan
content: Do you know that this sentence is my password? "Yang takkan pernah terlupakan selamanya dalam hidupku meskipun hanya sekejap saja tertanam dalam hati terpatri dalam sanubari" That's hilarious, right?! I know. But this is not about the password, this is about the code that I wrote along time ago. Deploying again even if failed in the test, haha... So now, here we are on 2026, where AI can make codes more easy to write. And honestly, I don't trust AI, anyway. So, I still make this shit manually far from the empire.
author: 9r3i

title: Iceberg Illusion
content:
This is what people see and what people don't see from us. When we were being judged by people, they don't know what they do.

They think they know us.
When we were suffering and struggling to survive or just to keep alive, they were not even see those things.

So now we are standing in the light, without they're knowing our sacrifices, or all the nights we've been through.

Have a good one, everyone.
author: 9r3i

title: Into the grey

title: Pray whoever you are
content:
Some people don't believe in God, but I do. So, I pray.

If you are one of them, congratulation! You are free from the rules of God. No one can stop you, right?

Let's gamble!
What if there is no God in the end?
I will get nothing, of course.
But, what if there is God in the end?
I won't be loss nothing, because I believe Him.

That's why I believe in God, and pray every single day.
Five times a day, exactly.
author: 9r3i
